data.name: Maisur
data.gender_notes: Maisur is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'ma'asara' which means 'helper'. This name is mentioned in the Hadith as the name of a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) who helped him during the Battle of Uhud. The name Maisur carries the meaning “Helper” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Maisur usually hope their child will grow to embody helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the strength and power of nature and the animal kingdom, inspiring a sense of awe and reverence for the natural world and its inhabitants
data.etymology: Maisur belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Helper.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Maisur total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_urdu.name: ميسور

in_urdu.long_meaning: ميسور ایک عربی نام ہے جو جڑ 'م-ي-س-ر' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے آسانی اور تیسیر۔ یہ نام زندگی میں آساني اور راحت کی طرف اشارہ کرتا ہے اور یہ بھی خوشحالی اور خوشحالی کی نشاندہی کرسکتا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کی روایت میں، یہ نام ان لوگوں کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو ایک آرام دہ اور ميسور زندگی گزارتے ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: मैसुर
in_hindi.meaning: यह नाम जीवन में आसानी और सुविधा की ओर संकेत करता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: मैसुर एक अरबी नाम है जो 'म-य-स-र' जड़ से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है आसानी और सुविधा। यह नाम जीवन में सुगमता और आराम की ओर इशारा करता है और यह समृद्धि और कल्याण का भी संकेत कर सकता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम उन लोगों के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो एक आरामदायक और समृद्ध जीवन व्यतीत करते हैं।

in_pashto.name: میسور

in_english.name: Maisur
in_english.meaning: This name indicates a life of ease and comfort

The name signifies a life of comfort and relaxation, and may also imply prosperity and well-being. In Islamic tradition, this name is used to describe individuals who enjoy a comfortable and affluent life. Etymologically, it relates to concepts of smoothness and accessibility in life.

historical_references.reference: Maisur was the name of a major port city in medieval Egypt. It was an important center of trade between the Mediterranean world and Africa.
historical_references.context: Maisur was located on the eastern bank of the Nile River, near modern-day Suez. It was a significant trading hub, with goods from Africa, the Middle East, and Europe passing through its markets.

historical_references.reference: Another reference to Maisur can be found in the works of the medieval Arab geographer, Ibn Battuta. He visited Maisur during his travel to Egypt in the 14th century and described it as a prosperous city with a large market and a mosque that was famous for its beautiful architecture.
historical_references.context: Ibn Battuta's account provides an insight into the economic and cultural significance of Maisur during the medieval period.
